summary: Fixed the live 114B/114B.1 forensic finding: pcae phase complete and pcae task finish --commit read pushed_status/origin_main_head_count from the declared, static .pcae/phase-completion-metadata.json instead of live git state, causing a genuinely pushed repository (origin/main..HEAD=0, confirmed by pcae push check) to be incorrectly quarantined because stale metadata still said not_pushed. Added src/pcae/core/push_state_reconciliation.py (compute_live_push_state(), reconcile_push_state()), making live git state authoritative for current push state whenever origin/main is resolvable; isolated repositories with no real remote fall back to declared metadata exactly as every finalization path did before this phase. Both lifecycle commands now use reconciled pushed_status/origin_main_head_count everywhere they previously read those fields straight from metadata -- live state wins in both directions, overriding a falsely-optimistic pushed claim just as readily as a stale not_pushed one. Discrepancies are printed unconditionally (metadata_push_state_stale plus both values), never silently resolved. certify_notification_transition(...) now evaluates notification eligibility against reconciled push state. No changes to pcae push/pcae push check, the Repository Transition Validator, Canonical Artifact Promotion, or notification dispatch mechanics; no event bus. Execution capability remains unavailable.
tests_added_or_updated: 14 focused push-state reconciliation tests added; notification/report/transition suites unchanged
